title: Reported Speech: Statement Practice — Quiz 122
content:
## Reported Speech: Statement Practice

Choose the correct tense for each reported statement.

### Lesson focus

1. Uncle said, “I have been vaccinated.”
2. He said, “I posted the letter yesterday.”
3. He said, “I was wearing double mask.”

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
